scripts.prompt:generate: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const {openuiChatPromptOptions}=require("@openuidev/react-ui"); const {myLibrary}=require("./openui-frontend/src/lib/my-library.tsx"); const prompt=myLibrary.prompt({...openuiChatPromptOptions, componentGroups: {...openuiChatPromptOptions.componentGroups, "Custom Cards": [myLibrary.components.WeatherCard]}, additionalRules: [...(openuiChatPromptOptions.additionalRules || []), "When the user asks for weather, call the Weather tool and render the result using WeatherCard.", "When the user asks about documentation, specs, pricing, or product features, call SearchDocsTool to retrieve accurate information before generating UI components."]}); fs.writeFileSync("config/system_prompt_openui.txt", prompt); console.log("Generated config/system_prompt_openui.txt with WeatherCard and SearchDocsTool");'
